title: Universal Aimbot and ESP Script
features:
Aimbot
Aimbot: Toggles the aimbot on or off.

Triggerbot: Automatically shoots when your crosshair is over an enemy.

Silent Aim: Aimbot projectiles without your camera locking on.

Aimbot Key: Set a custom key to activate the aimbot.

Aim Part: Choose which body part the aimbot targets (Head, Torso, HumanoidRootPart).

Aimbot Smoothness: Adjust how smoothly the aimbot moves to its target.

FOV Size: Change the size of the aimbot's field of view.

Show FOV: Toggles a visual circle for the aimbot's FOV on your screen.

Team Check: Prevents the aimbot from targeting your teammates.

Visible Check: Ensures the aimbot only targets players you can see.

Aim at Closest Player: Toggles between targeting the player closest to your crosshair or the player closest to your character.

Visuals (ESP)
ESP Enabled: Toggles all visual features on or off.

Box ESP: Draws a box around enemy players.

Tracers: Draws a line from the bottom of your screen to enemies.

Name ESP: Displays player names.

Health ESP: Shows player health bars.

Distance: Displays how far away players are.

Team Check: Prevents ESP from showing on your teammates.

Tracer Origin: Change where tracers start from (Bottom, Middle, Top).

Field of View: Adjust your in-game field of view.

ESP Color: Change the color of the ESP.

Player
Speed: Adjust your character's walk speed.

Jump Power: Change your character's jump height.

Infinite Jump: Allows you to jump multiple times in the air.

Anti-Fling: Helps prevent you from being flung by physics glitches.

Combat
Rapid Fire: Increases the fire rate of your weapons.

Utility
Anti-AFK: Prevents you from being kicked for being idle.

Server Hop: Teleports you to a different server in the same game.

Time of Day: Change the in-game time.

Settings
Accent Color: Change the main color of the UI.

Config System:

Config Name: Text box to name your config.

Save Config: Saves your current settings.

Load Config: Loads a previously saved config.

Toggle UI Keybind: Set a custom key to open and close the UI.

Kill Script: Closes and removes the UI.

Credits: Auaqa
